description: Today I am officially launching my re-election campaign in Florida’s 21st Congressional District. While the 21st Congressional District may be a new number, it is largely the same district consisting of Martin, St. Lucie and Palm Beach Counties that I’ve had the honor to serve in Congress over the last 5 years.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Mast for Congress Hon
title: Mast Launches Campaign In FL-21 - Mast for Congress | Mast for Congress
